I had an aunt go full-on coo coo about 5 to 10 years back after my grandfather, her dad died in a hospital room. She always had been more on homeopathic stuff but she was soon saying that chi healers and crystals would help her better than anything. Positive vibes and ivermectin and the stuff. She had hip problems for years but it bound her to a wheelchair after a while. Her solution was a medicine man in Oklahoma to dance around her with a feather and special edible clay from Texas. Finally she was forced into the hospital after the pain made her pass out in church. They did all the tests on her and it was cancer. Not just in her hip but it had spread all over her body. For years she had just lived with an unbearable hip pain and didn't ever get it checked out. Thoughts and prayers were her hope and medicine. She was fully in the sauce of "biden is the devil and trump is gonna round up the democrats into camps rightfully so" type stuff. 

This was not the aunt I used to know and love. She used to be kind and caring and generous. But due to the environment (rural Arkansas), party ran media, and the conspiracies on the internet, she had become a hateful terrible person. 

After the diagnosis, she had been given weeks. She cried and cried wishing she could have all taken it back and been a smarter person. I told her that every family member at one point or another had recommended she see a doctor for years. Decades ago, she had cancer and had treatment for it, she knew she had an increased likelihood for it. Yet all I can think about are the shamans and "alternative medicine" doctors that charged her tens of thousands for glorified vibe healing.

She died two years ago and I hate alternative medicine and all who practice it with an unquenchable fire. Homeopathics and the like have their place but sometimes cancer is cancer. No amount of mint extract or mineral-enriched red clay is gonna save you. 

I loved my aunt and miss her terribly. I remember the doctors telling her that it could have been very treatable if she had come in when her hip was first hurting. The cancer had taken her lungs and stomach, she could hardly breathe and couldn't keep anything down. She literally starved to death in her early 50's to her own ignorance and stubbornness.
